titleStmt.title: Draft Resolution Providing for the Acceptance of the Provisions of the Arms Traffic Convention

head.hi: Draft Resolution Providing for the Acceptance of the Provisions of the Arms Traffic Convention

div.p: The Powers represented at this Conference, recognising the great importance of bringing the international Traffic in Arms under regulation, declare their acceptance of the provisions of the Arms Traffic Convention concluded at St. Germain-en-Laye on 10th September 1919, and their intention of giving effect to those provisions at the earliest possible date. In making this declaration the United States, not being a member of the League of Nations, reserves its assent to any provisions of the Convention which require disputed questions to be submitted to the jurisdiction of the League. The United States Government is however prepared to furnish all information as to its proceedings under the Convention to the Central Authority established thereunder.

The other Powers represented at the Conference which are members of the League of Nations accept the above reservation so far as concerns themselves and will use their good offices to ensure that it shall be accepted by the other signatories of the Convention.
